title: XQS Tropical Nicotine Pouches - 8mg/Pouch
description: XQS Tropical tastes vibrant yet easy‑going, bringing Pineapple, Mango and Passion Fruit notes together for a rounded fruit profile that stays clear throughout use. Each slim, all‑white pouch fits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. This can contains 20 pouches in 8mg (Strong). Produced by XQS in Sweden, the range focuses on flavour clarity and simple strength choices in a discreet format. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
